subject: general
question:
‘B % D’ means ‘B is the brother of D’.

‘B & D’ means ‘B is the mother of D’.

'B × D’ means ‘B is the husband of D’.

‘B # D’ means ‘B is the sister of D’.

‘B $ D’ means ‘B is the son of D’.

‘B @ D’ means ‘B is the father of D’.

Which of the following statements is correct regarding the given expression?

P % Q $ S # R % U × T

options.text: P is the son of T.
S is the brother-in-law of T.
U is the mother’s brother of P.
P is the daughter of T.

Given: ‘P % Q $ S # R % U × T’

1) P % Q

'P % Q’ means 'P is the brother of Q'.

2) Q $ S

'Q $ R' means 'Q is son of S'.

3) S # R

'S # R' means 'S is sister of R'.

4) R % U

'R % U' means 'R is brother of U'.

5) U × T

'U × T’ means 'U is husband of T'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78f219cc1d81842845c981826a2249a32b946b75e50f6690ca156e4857ade49e.png] 

Hence, We can see that U is the mother’s brother of P.
